exact_statement:
theorem free_ising_factor_iff_threshold :
    ∀ (d : ℕ) (beta : ℝ), 3 ≤ d → 0 ≤ beta → (IsFactorOfIID d (Real.tanh beta) ↔ Real.tanh beta ≤ 1 / Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) - 1))
